sonnet.problem: This story card only restates the answer the baker just saw on card 7 (the fathers won't turn back for their sons). It works as a recap and reuses an answer already shown.
sonnet.rule: An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.

sonnet.problem: "two cities up the coast" adds a geographic setting. Jeremiah 47:4 only says to cut off every remaining ally from Tyre and Sidon.
sonnet.rule: No added settings. No setting the text doesn't give.

sonnet.problem: "Then a cry goes up" says what kind of speech this is and implies it comes after the previous verse. Verse 6 gives no speaker and does not say it is a cry. The card should use a plain lead-in instead.
sonnet.rule: When the text doesn't say who is speaking, he doesn't guess. He uses a plain lead-in, like "Then the psalm says…", and names a speaker only when the passage or its heading does.
